findings.issue: אַף is tagged as an affirmation particle, but “nariz de” treats it as a construct noun and makes absolute אֱלֹהִים its genitive, adding “nose” and dropping the particle.
Qal וַיִּחַר is smoothed as reflexive “se encendió”.
כִּי is only marked as a conjunction; “porque” selects the causal sense.
Active participle רֹכֵב is smoothed as stative “montado”.

notes: Mensajero, Jehová, el camino, adversario, asna, and the two mozos with him match the other tokens.
